overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the complainants offered no specific evidence of deliberation outside an open meeting, so the Board's denial was credited.

allegations.summary: Complainants alleged that board members conspired with town staff to eliminate a cemetery position, with deliberation before Town Meeting outside an open meeting.
allegations.key_passage: The complainants have not identified any specific instances of deliberation outside of an open meeting.

allegations.summary: Complaints alleged that two board members discussed the cemetery layoff before Town Meeting, which the AG considered in light of the quorum rule for a five-member board.
allegations.key_passage: Since a quorum of the body is three members, discussions between fewer than three members are not considered deliberation.
